full_inspection: All four complete native images of copy1site051 and copy2site127 were inspected. Every body line, numeral, margin and punctuation mark was compared. audit_127_details.jpg preserves the compared deletion, shared élèves point, copy2 centered point before aventure and gray margin point beside tant bien. Apart from the five recorded loci, the body readings agree.
original_transcription_comparison: Both original transcriptions were compared in full. The original copy2 deletion macro was confirmed with its lower-layer doubt. The checked copy1 élèves point is also present in copy2 and was restored; the newly observed centered and marginal points are explicitly qualified. The archive numbers are copy-specific.

entries.decision: retain the copy2-only centered point with unresolved status
entries.reason: A point-shaped trace appears at mid-letter height in the copy2 gap before aventure and is absent in copy1. The category records the body-reading difference, without deciding its origin or assigning a multiplication meaning.

entries.decision: retain the observed deletion with its doubtful underlayer
entries.reason: A continuous gray oblique stroke crosses the final s and extends beyond the typed character. The lower s is partly obscured and retains doubt; copy1 clearly has the unstruck s.

entries.decision: restore the shared doubtful point in copy2
entries.reason: The tiny baseline point after élèves is visible at the corresponding position in both impressions. The original copy2 source omitted it; its origin and textual role remain unresolved.

entries.decision: record the copy2 marginal point without assigning origin
entries.reason: The gray point beside tant bien is visible in copy2’s left margin. Its dot shape is retained with explicit doubt about origin and role, without handwriting attribution.
The lower-left inscriptions read51 and127. No authorship attribution is made.
